messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2026-02-10, the Boreal team observed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- As of 2025-04-22, the search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- On 2026-03-20, on-call for the Boreal team passed from Marcus to Lena. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- The Boreal team consists of Lena, after Marcus moved to the Atlas team on 2026-03-20. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
    earlier: The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-03-20; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-11-03 that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
- On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena. [valid 2025-06-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team observed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- On 2026-06-09, the Dune team observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2026-03-20, Marcus moved from the Boreal team to the Atlas team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
